lives.meaning: Remaining lives; nonnegative integer; no upper cap of five.

scrolls.meaning: Available reveal casts; nonnegative integer; no upper cap of five.

coins.meaning: Coin remainder after exchanges; 0..49 in settled play.

room_x.meaning: Current chamber x coordinate, 1..maze_size during play; 0 outside a run.

room_y.meaning: Current chamber y coordinate, 1..maze_size during play; 0 outside a run.

maze_size.meaning: 6, 10 or 15 during a run; 0 outside a run.

room_changes.meaning: Completed passage crossings this round, including encounter-producing crossings; recovery excluded.

monster_x.meaning: True monster chamber x; observation only, not a permanent HUD reveal.

monster_y.meaning: True monster chamber y; observation only, not a permanent HUD reveal.

reveal_active.meaning: Whether exact sampled monster coordinates are currently shown: 0 or 1.

danger_nearby.meaning: Whether the monster is one maze connection away in the settled state: 0 or 1.

round_seed.meaning: Unsigned 32-bit seed of the active round; zero outside a round. Menu text belongs to the seed_input target.

coordinates.room_cell: [x,y], one-based public chamber coordinates; not world distance
coordinates.position: [x,y,z] in engine world units, optional; no prescribed world origin or internal actor positions
coordinates.rect: [left,top,width,height] normalized to the actual game-client image, excluding borders
coordinates.local_position: [right,forward] normalized to 0..1 across the current chamber floor; optional movement aid

movement_template: Continuous view-relative cardinal keys; observe target rectangle while moving. No fixed press count or world coordinate is prescribed.

seed.syntax: Unsigned decimal integer; outer whitespace and leading zeros accepted.
seed.invalid_menu: Show range error and do not start.
seed.precedence: Last launch occurrence initializes menu; a valid menu edit overrides it for the next run.

requirement_groups.resources: ENTRY-02, KEY-01, PICKUP-02 through PICKUP-04, ECON-01, ECON-02
